Cq.bar_b_note: Neither serpent reaches the Fulgocobra board (olive scales, gold lightning veins, cream belly, hood): A is a flat black-and-yellow banded krait that rises into the air in its faint frames, and B is grounded but a dark, noisy mottle with a muddy coiled silhouette.

Eu.bar_b_note: The wolf's fur and sculpt are at Palworld-class creature finish, and B's thin white-violet arcs carry it, but the stiff legs-up faint that still sits off its shadow pulls it down.

Fl.bar_b_note: Standing and hit react match the owner's Stormcapra bar, but the faint frames sink it: in A the head is lost into a fleece lump, and in B the body flips onto its back and appears to lift off its shadow, with the black and white patches breaking up.

Rt.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elder villager with clear eyes, a strong white-hair silhouette and a moss-green and olive palette that sits naturally in the Meadows key art; the two sides look essentially the same.

Nd.bar_b_note: A murky brown-black grade with no purple storm sky, lightning or blue-green moss; flat magenta ring and slab telegraphs; a HUD covering about a third of each frame; a player creature that barely reads; and in B the camera inside foliage for several frames.

top_changes.change: Nd: replace the flat magenta telegraph rings and slabs with real white-violet lightning and ground-crack effects that land with an impact; regrade Stormwood to its board (fixed purple storm sky, blue-green moss, rim light on both fighters); add camera collision or occlusion fade for trunks and canopy; and make the HUD side and bottom panels smaller and more translucent so the action and the player's creature read.

Ground every faint: keep the body on the stage with contact shadows (Cq A faint mid/end, Eu faint mid/end, Fl B faint mid), and author faint-end poses that keep the head and face readable (Fl A fleece lump, Eu stiff legs-up pose).

Rebuild the Fulgocobra skin and form to its board: olive-green scales, thin bright gold lightning veins, a cream belly and a clear hood and head silhouette, in place of the flat yellow bands (A) or the dark noisy mottle (B).
